scope: Owner-approved source custody and import/reuse engineering only; root alone reviews and accepts. No cryptographic/security acceptance or full audit claim.

approved_contract.registration_attestation: none; require fmt none and empty attStmt
approved_contract.origin: one exact configured origin; no cross-origin/top-origin ceremonies
approved_contract.rp_id: one exact configured RP ID; require matching SHA-256 RP ID hash
approved_contract.user_verification: required in browser request and server response flags
approved_contract.size_note: Proposed fail-closed 32 KiB serialized request plus per-field/decoded aggregate limits; finalize application route budget and binary/CBOR sublimits before implementation.
approved_contract.server_platform: native Node built-in crypto; no installed verifier/crypto math/ASN.1 package
approved_contract.extensions: Proposed minimal policy rejects ED/unrequested extensions; root must settle contract before runtime use.

inventory_method.method: Task-written local Python lexical scan of all custodied .ts files, skipping comments/quoted/template strings; collects top-level import/export-from declarations and literal/nonliteral import()/require() calls; resolves relative paths and nearest preserved deno.json import map. No acquired source is imported or executed.
inventory_method.runtime_type_rule: Syntax-based: import type/export type and inline type-only binding lists are type_only; mixed binding lists carry both symbol sets; unmarked import/export bindings are conservative runtime edges even if compiler elision/tree shaking removes them. No compiler/emitted-code closure or transitive external-package contents inferred.
limits: Imports constructed via strings/eval or in template-expression executable code cannot be fully established by this lexical inventory. Independent raw import()/require()/eval/new Function search found no such call indicators in acquired files.
External import maps record declared version ranges, not an exact installed package or verified transitive closure; unacquired dependencies are not assumed resolved.
No downloaded scripts, builds, installs, upstream test fixtures or network fetches were executed.
inventory_method.scope_note: All 117 acquired manifest files are represented through 105 TypeScript file/import records plus 12 noncode manifest records. Extra local README and SOURCE-MANIFEST are intake documentation.

useful_parts: decodePartialCBOR/decodeCBOR, decodeNext, map duplicate-key detection, major-type constants and decodeLength; retain consumed-byte result
adaptation_required: Build an explicitly bounded decoder for only schema-needed integer, byte-string, text-string and map values; add 32 KiB envelope/decoded-data caps, depth/item/string/byte budgets before allocation or recursion.

Add per-read bounds, exact byte-string lengths, shortest permitted integer/length encoding, fatal UTF-8 behavior and exact input consumption; reject unsupported floats/tags/indefinite lengths/ambiguous values according to the owned contract.
Handle DataView.byteOffset and Uint8Array.byteOffset/byteLength explicitly; raw decoder constructs views/slices from backing buffers and cannot be treated as a bounded view adapter.
Do not import full encoder/CBORTag/general-purpose values just to find COSE length; preserve original wire slice and advance by decoder consumed bytes.

useful_parts: Attestation object labels fmt, authData and attStmt; empty attStmt requirement comes from verifyRegistrationResponse none branch
adaptation_required: Replace iso/index.ts barrel/tiny-cbor bare import with owned narrow decoder.
Require fmt exactly none, attStmt exactly an empty map and bounded authData bytes; reject other attestation formats and unexpected/duplicate schema members by the chosen contract.
Use exact full-object consumption; upstream decodeFirst discards the consumed length.
Retain only supported schema/constants; remove broad algorithm predicates that accept EdDSA/PQC/other algorithms.
Require alg/kty/curve agreement and exact coordinate or modulus/exponent byte types/length policy; reject private parameters, unsupported labels and ambiguous maps according to the contract.
Convert validated public data to Node-supported key input (for example JWK); validate native key import/verification independently before use.

useful_parts: 37-byte prefix, RP hash, UP/UV/BE/BS/AT/ED bits, big-endian counter, registration AAGUID and credential-ID length layout
adaptation_required: Check every offset and declared slice before reads; impose 32 KiB and credential/key/extension budgets.
Require UP and UV; reject BE or BS true; require AT for registration and disallow unexpected AT for assertion.
Remove the Firefox/EdDSA input-mutation workaround; unsupported algorithms are rejected.
Use consumed-byte counts and original key bytes, not decode/re-encode length; require exact final consumption.
Choose and document an extension policy before runtime adoption; default proposed minimal policy rejects ED and unexpected extension outputs.

useful_parts: clientDataJSON field names and ceremony-specific type/challenge/origin checks in verifier references
adaptation_required: Replace isoBase64URL dependency with bounded native decoding and fatal UTF-8; require object/field types and chosen duplicate-member policy.
Hash original decoded clientDataJSON bytes, not reserialized JSON.
Require webauthn.create or webauthn.get exactly, exact expected challenge and one exact origin; reject crossOrigin true and any topOrigin for this same-origin-only contract.

useful_parts: BE/BS extraction semantics and impossible single-device backed-up combination
adaptation_required: Owned contract rejects either flag true at both registration and assertion; the upstream helper allows BE=true and therefore is not the complete policy.

useful_parts: Byte concatenation, comparison and bounded DataView patterns
adaptation_required: Prefer direct owned/native helpers; remove unused ASCII/hex/string convenience functions and iso/index.ts imports.
Document timing-safe challenge/hash comparison where appropriate and use Node built-ins for server operations.

useful_parts: atob/btoa with Uint8Array conversion; descriptor ID conversion
adaptation_required: Enforce canonical unpadded base64url alphabet/length/round-trip and per-field/envelope 32 KiB limits before allocation; these raw convenience helpers do not impose them.
Restrict option/response schema; use native browser types or owned minimal interfaces instead of generated full DOM types.

useful_parts: navigator.credentials.create/get invocation, binary option conversion, null/error handling and raw response serialization
adaptation_required: Write owned wrapper with attestation:none, explicit ES256/RS256, exact RP ID and userVerification required; server enforces all policies independently.
Keep explicit credential allow/exclude lists and server account binding; remove auto-registration, conditional autofill, broad capability discovery and backward-call compatibility.
Serialize only approved raw fields with bounds; do not trust getPublicKey/getPublicKeyAlgorithm/browser extension outputs for server verification.

useful_parts: AbortController per active ceremony and native WebAuthn feature presence check
adaptation_required: Define ownership/lifecycle of AbortController in the application; cancellation never accepts a server challenge or bypasses atomic single-use checks.

useful_parts: Native error categories for registration/authentication and cancellation
adaptation_required: Use a small application error mapping; do not copy domain heuristics as the exact-origin/RP security policy or expose raw challenge/key material in errors.

useful_parts: Registration type/challenge/origin/RP-hash/UP/UV/credential-data/algorithm checks and fmt none with empty attStmt
adaptation_required: Implement the explicit owned contract; whole files import attestation families, settings, broad algorithm handling and external packages.
Make RP hash validation mandatory; validate returned credential ID against decoded registration credential ID, not merely id===rawId.
Bind account/purpose/session/epoch/expiry and atomically consume stored random challenge with credential persistence in the application.

useful_parts: Assertion type/challenge/origin/RP/UP/UV checks; signature payload authData || SHA256(original clientDataJSON); signCount comparison
adaptation_required: Implement strict same-origin and ES256/RS256 policy without advancedFIDO exceptions/settings/PQC code.
Verify assertion ID matches the stored allowed credential and userHandle/account policy; choose signCount zero behavior explicitly.
Use Node native crypto and require successful signature before any acceptance; atomically consume challenge/update counter with session/account/purpose/epoch/expiry binding.

useful_parts: Random challenge/hash/one-RP matching requirements; EC2/RSA public key-to-JWK field mapping and signature input expectations
adaptation_required: Use node:crypto randomBytes/createHash/createPublicKey/verify or reviewed native equivalents, with explicit SHA-256/P-256 or RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 algorithm policy.
Keep DER ECDSA wire signature with an explicitly verified Node dsaEncoding contract where supported; do not copy ASN.1 unwrap or private crypto arithmetic.
Specify RSA modulus/exponent and DER signature bounds; independently generate keys/signatures and test algorithm confusion/forgeries before acceptance.

excluded_categories.reason: Only attestation:none is approved; no X.509 chains, certificate policy, trust stores or direct/enterprise attestation families.
No CRL fetch, metadata JWT/MDS, remote roots, network client or metadata refresh timer in runtime closure.
Node built-in crypto replaces dispatch/import/digest/random wrappers; no AKP/PQC/OKP/other algorithms, broad runtime probes, ASN.1 dependency or automatic algorithm enablement.
Import reviewed owned narrow modules directly; upstream barrels conservatively pull excluded export/dependency paths.
Signal APIs, autofill/conditional mediation, passkey capability discovery and attachment convenience output are not needed for explicit hardware-key ceremonies.
Preserve as reference only; no upstream build/publish/version scripts, benchmark execution, copied fixture acceptance or full generated DOM/types runtime imports.

Validate returned IDs/userHandle against allowed stored credential/account; maintain counter policy and atomic updates.
Compose existing TOTP prerequisite, Owner/delegated capabilities, two fixed Owner credentials, independent recovery and private-debate boundaries.

Set signCount zero/non-increasing behavior and atomic challenge/counter/credential transaction semantics.
